limitations: Cross-position point averages are not direct upgrade evidence; positional requirements and FLEX lineup strength need analysis.
NFL carries, targets and receptions are integrated where ID matched; snaps, routes, injuries, competition and trade appeal still require dated research before any bid.
Weekly averages use three verified calendar-week Yahoo league scores including zero-point bye weeks; missing scores never silently become zero or shrink the denominator.
No automatic claims, roster changes, FAAB recommendations or lineup changes.
Wednesday FA contingencies must be reverified as FA after waiver processing.
